fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the upcoming October 27 election concerning an $800,000 auditorium/convention hall proposal; discussion of Miami Beach and Coral Gables venues versus a Miami facility and references to Mayor Ev Sewell and publisher Frank B. Shutts. Reports criticize the City of Miami welfare board's grocery-order system and pricing at its provision store, and discuss criminal justice topics including publicity in a justice of the peace court and Florida's pardoning process. Additional items cover the Homestead Bank situation and a possible transfer of a municipal power company to Florida Power & Light, local business and development notes, entertainment listings, and sports coverage including boxing at the Ball Park and a humorous preview of a 'Greeby Hiccough School' football game.
